**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation running against Sanofi. Full-text and regex sweeps for "most favoured/favored nation", "no less favourable", "at least as favourable", "best terms", "comparable/equally favourable terms", "right of first refusal", "right to match" and "first negotiation" returned nothing responsive on the Customer side. The single third-party-terms mechanic (the SHP1-SHP2 Dual Inhibitor right of first negotiation, p0263) binds RevMed — it must negotiate exclusively with Sanofi and is barred from negotiating with Third Parties during the negotiation period — so it benefits us and is not flagged. The "rights of first refusal" reference in p0019 is definitional (Change of Control / control-acquisition carve-out), not a pricing or terms MFN. No redline proposed.
